sources.title: Algebraic Solutions of the Lamé Equation, Revisited
sources.claim_scope: Algebraic form of the Lame equation L_{ell,B} on P^1 with singular points e_1,e_2,e_3 (exponents 0, 1/2) and infinity (exponents -ell/2, (ell+1)/2), eq.(1.1); the Weierstrass form on C is the strong pullback of the algebraic form by x = wp(t) (Sec.5, eq.(5.1)); harmonic case J = 1 (g3 = 0) has {e_i} = alpha{-1,0,1} (Def.3.2); classical facts quoted: G(L_{ell,B}) is never cyclic and can be dihedral only if 2 ell in Z (Sec.1, Thm 3.1 proof); Thm 3.1 necessary conditions for finite projective monodromy when 2 ell not in Z; Thm 5.1 finiteness on E equivalent to finiteness on P^1.
sources.notes: Digest is SHA-256 of https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0206285v1 as served at retrieved_at. Uses ell for the degree parameter and explicitly distinguishes it from other integers, matching this WO's invariant.

sources.title: Characterization and enumeration on Lamé equations with finite monodromy
sources.authors_or_authority: You-Cheng Chou, Chin-Lung Wang, Po-Sheng Wu
sources.claim_scope: Lame equation (1.1) on a torus and its algebraic form (1.2) p(x) w'' + p'(x)/2 w' - (n(n+1)x + B) w = 0 with p = 4x^3 - g2 x - g3, exponents {0,1/2} at e_i and {-n/2,(n+1)/2} at infinity; Theorem 1.2 (Brioschi-Halphen-Crawford): for m in Z_{>=0} there is a weighted homogeneous polynomial p_m(B; g2, g3) of degree m+1 in B with coefficients in Z[g2/4, g3/4] such that p_m(B) = 0 iff the algebraic Lame equation with n = m + 1/2 has finite projective monodromy K_4; Theorem 1.5 (Beukers-van der Waall) list of n not in N/2 with finite monodromy; finiteness of the four monodromies (ordinary/projective, torus/P^1) is equivalent (Sec.2.2).
sources.notes: Digest is SHA-256 of https://arxiv.org/pdf/2402.16286v1 as served at retrieved_at. NOT bound here: the Lame-Hermite statement that integer-ell Lame equations have Liouvillian solutions for every B, and the statement that for half-integer ell with p_m(B) != 0 the group is SL_2; both remain expectation-only and are decided computationally by the qualified provider.

LAME_CLASSIFICATION_AUTHORITY: PARTIAL: bound for (i) the algebraic form and its pullback relation, (ii) finite-monodromy necessary conditions for 2 ell not in Z, (iii) the Brioschi-Halphen-Crawford characterization of finite projective monodromy for half-integer ell. NONE for the integer-ell Liouvillian statement and for the non-finite half-integer case.
